# bera/ui

> Reusable motion for existing React interfaces: 15 standalone transition recipes, CSS host adapters, live tuning, and an optional coding-agent skill.

Read the host project and preserve its primitives, state ownership, and styles. Standalone components default to natural sizing and preview=false. Standalone registry installation adds the original recipe; pass chosen speed and radius in the consuming code. CSS host adapters use their documented custom properties instead. Review dependency changes and each recipe's integration boundary.

## Integration

- [Agent guide](https://bera-ui.vercel.app/agents): choose a registry install, portable kit, or skill.
- [Catalog](https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/manifest.json): IDs, props, compatibility, and source paths.
- [shadcn registry](https://bera-ui.vercel.app/r/registry.json): discover recipes; install with npx shadcn@latest add https://bera-ui.vercel.app/r/<id>.json.
- [Skill](https://bera-ui.vercel.app/bera-motion.SKILL.md): discover, review, apply, and refine workflow.
- [Portable kit](https://bera-ui.vercel.app/bera-motion.tar.gz): complete source, styles, recipes, and zero-dependency local installer.

## Recipes

- [State button](https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/state-button.agent.md): Save and submit actions that already have pending/success/error state.
- [Sliding tabs](https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/sliding-tabs.agent.md): A small set of modes, filters, or views with an existing selected value.
- [Morphing menu](https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/morphing-menu.agent.md): A compact action trigger opening a nearby set of commands.
- [Text swap](https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/text-swap.agent.md): Short status messages that change as an operation progresses.
- [Expanding search](https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/expanding-search.agent.md): Compact search or filter controls that need more space on focus.
- [Toast stack](https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/toast-stack.agent.md): A notification system with multiple recent messages.
- [Copy feedback](https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/copy-button.agent.md): Copying a command, URL, identifier, or other text.
- [Rolling counter](https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/rolling-counter.agent.md): Adjustable integer quantities, totals, or compact counters.
- [Accordion](https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/accordion.agent.md): Expandable help, preferences, and short supporting details.
- [Icon morph](https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/morphing-icon-button.agent.md): A menu or panel toggle that needs a clear change of state.
- [Inline edit](https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/inline-edit.agent.md): Project names, short titles, and metadata that can be edited in place.
- [Animated list](https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/animated-list.agent.md): Changing file lists, search results, queues, or selected items.
- [Selection toolbar](https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/selection-toolbar.agent.md): Bulk actions for selected files, messages, or table rows.
- [Play / pause](https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/playback-toggle.agent.md): Play and pause controls for video, audio, or user-controlled animation.
- [Confirm action](https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/confirm-action.agent.md): Confirming an archive, removal, reset, or other consequential action in context.

## Host adapters

- [Radix menu motion](https://bera-ui.vercel.app/adapters/radix-menu-motion.agent.md): An existing Radix or Radix-based shadcn dropdown menu whose behavior and styles must stay host-owned.
